list: the official 55 trophies, as published on PlayStation and verified against GTABase, PowerPyx, Insider Gaming and PSNProfiles, 20 November 2026
note: Names and descriptions are the official ones. Guides are written for this entry, in our own words, and name the source each fact came from. Where no published guide has confirmed the steps yet, the guide says so and works from the official description alone.

trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned. There is nothing extra to do for it: follow the roadmap in this guide, finish the story, then work the 100% checklist for A Long Road, which is where most of the roughly 200 hours goes. No trophy needs online play, DLC or a second playthrough, and there are no difficulty settings to worry about. Keep cheats off for the whole run, because using one disables trophies and saving.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide (via GTA-Zone and SixShore)

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Play Gone Fishing, one of the first missions of Chapter 1, and the trophy unlocks when it ends. Nothing special is needed: just follow the mission objectives.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish Chapter 1; the trophy is awarded once you have played the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag? While you are still in Chapter 1, do not skip Lucia's balcony meditation the morning after Down to Earth — it is tied to the one trophy that may be missable, Positive Mental Attitude.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Play through Chapter 2; the trophy is awarded as Chapter 3 begins, after the mission Welcome to Vice City. Chapter 2 is also when both characters can be together after Coffee Break, which opens up partner trophies such as Hot Together and Retail Therapy.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish Chapter 3; the trophy arrives after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Chapter 3 opens several trophy lines at once: Andy's quests, Tyrone's labs, Yasmani's jewelry jobs and the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering Marked Bills.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete Chapter 4 and the trophy pops. Chapter 4 is where the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… opens the bank vault robberies, so take it when it appears — the vaults feed Maximum Withdrawal, Dime on the Dollar and the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish the last mission of the story and the gold is yours. Free roam carries on after the credits, so every remaining trophy can be cleaned up afterwards — there is no mission replay, but no trophy depends on how you play a mission.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks in the natural course of the story — no extra objectives are needed.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 mission. Play the story normally and it pops at the end of the mission.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play. It unlocks in the natural course of the story.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the Chapter 4 mission Headliners. It unlocks in the natural course of the story.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown. It unlocks in the natural course of the story. The airport you visit here is also the setting for the Catch Me If You Can trophy, which you can attempt in free roam afterwards.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory. It unlocks in the natural course of the story, near the end of the campaign.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy, and the longest: the 100% checklist appears under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, after the story — but everything you did before the credits already counts, and nothing on it is missable. It does not ask for literally everything. Needed in full: all robberies (including all 8 bank vaults and all 39 gang operations), the underwater discoveries, every Shooting Range gold medal, all drone races and Bret's 15 Target Decks. Only a share of the rest: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts and 100 WAiNK scans. Expect around 100 hours on this stage alone. Work it with the checklist open and tick off whole categories at a time rather than jumping around the map.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Any 250 of the 397 stunts count, in any mix: 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Flying under bridges is the fastest way to pile them up, and the optional challenge on each stunt is not needed. Check your count under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, and turn on Stunt Spots on the map. Keep going past 250 — the 100% checklist wants 300.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one basket), an arcade game, winning a race (a car race, a race challenge or a Top Fun drone race) and a stunt. Progress, then Activities, shows what is left. Most of these happen naturally while chasing other trophies, so this one usually pops on its own early in the cleanup.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge: 42 golds across 12 ranges. Ranges also raise your Focus level, which makes the Gunslinger trophy easier, so do the ranges before you attempt that one. All 42 golds are also required for the 100% checklist, so there is no shortcut around them.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. One win per location is enough for this trophy, but the 100% checklist wants all 42 drone races, so finish every race at a location while you are there rather than coming back later.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 available. Winning the same race twice does not count, so keep moving to new events. Short, easy races count the same as long ones, so pick the quickest events first and save the harder ones for later.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After you meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, he texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple icon. Play through his fishing quests and beat him in his challenge. Fishing also counts toward the Master of None activity list, so this quest line does double duty.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Reach the end of any one arcade game. Three of them — Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind — are on the TV at home, and the fourth, Bang For Your Buck, is on arcade cabinets around Leonida. Pick the shortest one you enjoy and play it through; finishing also counts as an activity for Master of None.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's quests are Lucia-only and start in Chapter 3, when he texts her an address in Belville. Do all five in order: Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. The last one awards the trophy. They stay available after the story, so there is no rush — but Andy's line does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton — green KR icon in Key Lento — hires you in Chapter 1 to recover treasure from 7 shipwrecks. Dive at the purple chest markers and use the metal detector to dig the treasure up. He disappears after Chapter 1 and texts Jason again later, so you can finish the line then. Track it under Progress, then Collections, then Kenton's Treasures.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's five jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. The fifth, Hometown Heroes, unlocks the trophy. They stay available after the story. Like Andy's line, Billy's does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 qualifying stranger strands. Not every side quest line counts: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete do, while the quest lines of Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. Which other strands qualify is still being confirmed by the guide sites, so check the trophy's progress counter in your trophy list as you go. None of them are needed for 100%, and all of them stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission that gets you the Key Cloner, Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS. Deliver the 16 sports cars on his list to his garage in west Vice City (RK icon). Scan cars with the WAiNK app to see if they are on the list; hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are the best places to look. Cars in better condition pay more, so drive carefully on the delivery run.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason-only. After Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, Tyrone has you destroy the synthetic labs marked in purple around Vice City. Once enough are gone, his last job, Shut Down the Labs, awards the trophy. Tyrone's line does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE TROPHY THAT MAY BE MISSABLE. Meditate at every Meditation Spot until the counter reaches 18; meditating at a spot with Jason and Lucia together counts twice. The last one needs both characters, which is possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Track it under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. The risk is in Chapter 1: the morning after Down to Earth, follow Lucia from the kitchen to the balcony and accept her meditation. That spot is gone after Chapter 1, and it is not confirmed yet whether the trophy needs it — so do not skip it. PowerPyx and GTABase both flag this as the only possibly missable trophy in the game.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide (via GTA-Zone, SixShore and EGamers)

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret's hunting quests start after Coffee Break in Chapter 2: he texts Jason, and Veteran Hunted in Lummox County kicks things off. Hunt the animals on his Target Decks (purple icons) and bring them back as Jason. A clean one-shot kill pays more but is not required. Which animal triggers the trophy is not confirmed yet, but the 100% checklist needs all 15 Target Decks anyway, so work through the whole set.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 Collectible Card sets out of the 18 in the game — you do not need all of them. The Collections section of the Progress menu shows how close each set is, so pick the three nearest to done and hunt their missing cards first. Cards turn up all over Leonida, so keep an eye out while travelling between other objectives.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK spots with the WAiNK phone app: hold Up on the D-pad, then R1 (RB on Xbox). Any 100 count, from the 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and the No Flusher tags. Scan as you travel from the start of the game — the 100% checklist wants 100 WAiNK scans too, so this folds straight into the cleanup.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges; Progress, then Challenges, marks finished ones with a tick. Many complete themselves while you play, and the 100% checklist needs 70, so this one comes along the way. Near the end, open the Challenges menu and pick off the easiest unfinished ones.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Possible once both characters are together, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Call your partner (hold Right on the D-pad, then Triangle / Y), get a 4-star Wanted Level and escape. It only counts once you are out of the red heat zone. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County shakes off cops and helicopters well. Bank vault robberies always give 4 stars, so it often unlocks there on its own.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row while you are still wanted (flashing red and blue). Go in with body armor, sticky bombs and healing items. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City — open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 — are close together, which makes the run quick. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to appear after the third shop; if it does not, rob a fourth.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Scan 100 different vehicles with the WAiNK app — you do not need to drive them. Stand next to a busy road and scan passing traffic to rack up new models fast. The 100% checklist needs 200 base models, so you will get this anyway on the road to A Long Road.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single Combat Focus (click both sticks while aiming). It only lasts a few seconds, so fill your Focus first — eat, drink or wash up at home; Adrenaline makes it last longer — and use an assault rifle. Gang operation thugs work well; cops, soldiers and civilians do not seem to count. Do the Shooting Ranges first: they raise your Focus level, which helps here.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At VCIA airport, steal one of the big passenger jets docked at a departure gate's boarding bridge — planes parked out on the airfield do not count. Back it out, take off and get about 1 km away from the airport. Gates E3 and E4 are the easiest: drive through the airfield fence and use the door by the stairs next to the boarding bridge.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station on the southwest island of Mariana County — the tanks are at the south end of the base — and take out enemies from inside it until the trophy pops. Expect heavy resistance getting in and out, so bring armor and a fast escape vehicle parked nearby.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 give you the Snap Gun. Use it on a jewelry store's locked back door — kicking it in sets off the alarm — find the note with the safe code in the back room and empty the safe without being spotted. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City works well for this.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Bank vaults open up with the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…. Follow a security van to its bank and get into the vault while it is open. The haul is too heavy for one character, so hand a bag to your partner. Vaults always give 4 stars: escape on a fast bike, then switch vehicles. 5 of the 8 vaults are enough here, but the 100% checklist needs all 8, and each pays up to $205,000. Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000 if you want a shortcut to the next one.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Robbing a bank vault counts for this, as long as you then escape the red heat zone or get to a Pay 'n' Spray — so it usually pops while working on Maximum Withdrawal. Before vaults open, you can box in an armored truck, put a sticky bomb on its back doors, blow them open and get away.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Clear the fog from the whole map of Leonida. The quickest way is by plane, flying over every dark patch until the map is fully revealed. Do it late in the run, when you already know the map — most of it will be cleared naturally by then, and you can sweep the leftovers in one flight.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal gang operation (yellow map icons) from each of the 9 gangs; Progress, then Gangs, keeps count. The 100% checklist needs all 39 operations, so keep robbing after this pops. Gang operation thugs also make good targets for the Gunslinger trophy.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No published guide has confirmed the exact steps for this one yet. From the official description alone: have a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach in Vice City — look for a bar or lounge overlooking the beach and order a drink there. GTABase lists the trophy with its steps unconfirmed, so check back there for an update if it does not pop. Do not confuse it with the Chapter 4 mission Ocean Beach, which is a different thing.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide (steps unconfirmed as of 18 Nov 2026)

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: No published guide has confirmed the exact steps for this one yet. The description points to crashing a car out through the window of a vehicle showroom — the classic GTA move. GTABase and PowerPyx both list the steps as not yet known, so the honest advice is: try driving a car through a showroom's front window, and check GTABase for a confirmed method if it does not pop.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide (steps unconfirmed as of 18 Nov 2026)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide (via EGamers: steps not yet known)

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is a gang operation, first marked by Hit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2. Take its three valuables: the luxury watch in the southeast office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the northeast table and the safe in the northeast hallway (bring sticky bombs). The trophy pops once you lose the police. You do not need all three in one visit, but the robbery takes a long time to come back, so try to grab them together.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia (Jason & Lucia, then Strength, in the pause menu). Work out at fitness clubs — Map, then Activities — with your partner along: training one trains the other too. After the story you can also train at home. It is a slow grind, so start the workouts early and fit them in between other jobs.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Most players get it without trying; turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings, then UI, to watch the count climb. One warning from GTABase and PowerPyx: do not push towards the Irredeemable profile — it is permanent. Play normally and let the count build.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: No published guide has confirmed the exact steps for this one yet. The description — 'Second time's the charm' — suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt, but which attempt, and where, is still unknown. PowerPyx marks it as not yet known and GTABase lists it unconfirmed. Play the story and side content normally and watch the guide sites for a confirmed method; do not waste hours guessing.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide (steps unconfirmed as of 18 Nov 2026)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide (via EGamers: steps not yet known)

trophies.guide: No published guide has confirmed the exact steps for this one yet. Expect a strange event or Easter egg somewhere in Leonida — GTABase guesses along those lines but stresses it is unconfirmed, and PowerPyx marks it as not yet known. Explore odd corners of the map as you clean up, and check GTABase for a confirmed location once players have found it.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide (steps unconfirmed as of 18 Nov 2026)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide (via EGamers: steps not yet known)

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No published guide has confirmed the exact steps for this one yet. The description points to knocking people down with a melee attack from a vehicle — a melee drive-by. PowerPyx marks the steps as not yet known and GTABase lists them unconfirmed. Try melee attacks from a slow-moving vehicle against grouped pedestrians, and check GTABase for a confirmed method if it does not pop.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide (steps unconfirmed as of 18 Nov 2026)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide (via EGamers: steps not yet known)

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) in Chapter 3 gets you the Dye Pack Jammer. Rob banks and Payday Loans, then sell the marked bills to fences; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. It is a running total, so the robberies you do for the 100% checklist get you most of the way there — just remember to fence the bills instead of letting them pile up.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: A running total of $100,000 across every kind of shop. Guns, car mods and tattoos use it up fastest. It comes naturally over a long run, but if you are short near the end, a few expensive vehicle upgrades will close the gap quickly.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy the 8 garages for sale in the Vice City Real Estate phone app — available after Daily Driver in Chapter 2 — for about $160,000 in total. The 4 garages the story gives you do not count. Garage space is also needed for the On the Spot registrations, so buy the garages before you start registering vehicles.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Moses' Chapter 2 mission gets you the Scooter Bros app. Take stolen vehicles to his garage in Port Gellhorn, respray them and register them. At first he only takes cars without trackers; from Chapter 3, any Pay 'n' Spray registers tracked ones. You need free garage space (see Little Boxes) and each registration costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes.
trophies.name: On the Spot
